thread:
lauren: Quick idea — a one-line "goal snapshot" + 24h micro-pulse for peers. Should be copy/pasteable and done in <3 mins. Thoughts?

lauren: SNAPSHOT (pasteable):
Team: [team]
Quarter: Q3 2026
Owner: [name]
North Star (1 line): [outcome]
Why it matters (1 line): [customer / biz impact]
Top 3 KRs (metric + target) + confidence (0-10):
 - KR1: [metric target] (conf: 7)
 - KR2: [metric target] (conf: 6)
 - KR3: [metric target] (conf: 5)
Top 3 actions (est effort S/M/L):
 - Action A (M)
 - Action B (L)
 - Action C (S)
Key dependency/blocker: [who/what]
Primary signal to watch: [metric]
One-line ask to manager: [unblock/prioritize/hire]
Peer micro-pulse (DM 3 peers; 3 one-line prompts):
 - Biggest customer impact?
 - What to deprioritize?
 - Anything missing?
Self-review tip (end of cycle):
 - For each KR: 1-line "what worked" + 1-line "evidence/metric"
 - Finish with 1-line lesson + 1 clear ask

diego: Love it. Add a one-word KR risk tag (infra/data/headcount) so managers can triage.

amanda: Please include 3 micro-reply templates to make peer replies fast (one-liners).

lauren: Micro-replies examples:
 - "Prioritize KR1; drop Action C"
 - "Clarify how KR2 maps to revenue"
 - "Targets look high; suggest -15% or add hire"

people-ops-bot: Template uploaded -> https://redwoodhq.internal/goals/snapshot. Auto-DM scheduled. :calendar:

lauren: Rollout checklist: add examples for SWE/PM/ML infra, wire to handbook, create DM button, run a 5-min manager demo tomorrow.

diego: Suggest default confidence=6 to nudge calibration.

amanda: +1. Also add a one-word KR risk field by default.

lauren: Will post filled examples tonight and open a short manager feedback thread tomorrow AM. Thanks! :tada:
